scope: Opt-in resumable Lisp function compilation and execution-context/task infrastructure; not a Lisp thread API or a scheduler. Actual generator suspension is tested with compiled Lisp in Node and Chrome.

implementation.compiler: Internal COMPILER::*RESUMABLE-FUNCTIONS* flag emits generator-backed functions and delegated named/local/FUNCALL/MULTIPLE-VALUE-CALL calls. Function entries and loop backedges yield checkpoints. Ordinary compilation remains the default.
implementation.runtime: WeakMap alternate implementations preserve ordinary JS function identity. Execution contexts save bindings, multiple values and call-stack arrays. ResumableTask advances within a checkpoint budget and propagates exceptions through suspended cleanup.
implementation.synchronousBoundary: Ordinary callbacks ignore checkpoints but reject explicit suspension by throwing through the generator, so UNWIND-PROTECT and dynamic bindings clean up.

kernel.scope: Existing8kernel tests plus interleaved values/backtraces/global writes, bounded checkpoints, interrupted cleanup that itself suspends, synchronous callback use and rejection cleanup.

node.command: npm --prefix tests run build:performance && node tests/performance/verify.mjs

browser.scope: Load and supplied API assertions; GUI verification is separate

lisp.browserScope: Fresh Chrome module worker; core and test fixture compiled for browser, Alexandria loaded in ordinary mode. This is not a claim that arbitrary Alexandria callbacks can suspend.
coverage: Nested/local/FUNCALL calls and shared mutable arrays across interleaved tasks
Special parameters, optional initializer suspension, caller binding restoration
Recursive nonlocal RETURN-FROM, CATCH/THROW and HANDLER-CASE
Cleanup that suspends while retaining protected multiple values
MULTIPLE-VALUE-CALL, zero-value completion and ordinary synchronous calls
Budget-limited loop progress and named function redefinition across suspension

controlRegressions.preparation: Prelude asserts that COMPILE returns a function with a registered generator implementation. All104registered cases execute and pass in eachmode.
controlRegressions.scope: Existing compiler/control cases run with generator lowering and synchronous facades; explicit interleaving is covered separately by43Lisp checks.

fixtureCorrections: Initial loop test assumed that3checkpoints implied the first loop iteration had completed. Final bounded test requires an observable intermediate counter and full completion, without assuming the number of entry checkpoints.

The completion marker uses FFI:SET on GLOBALTHIS; SETF FFI:REF is unsupported and assigning a new bare global identifier fails in strict ES modules. Both initial fixture failures were rejected by the strict verifier.

freshMcclim.scope: Real upstream CLIM pattern, clipping, composite-design, pixmap-copy and multiline-text assertions, plus Bezier curves, areas, unions, differences and output replay, plus solid flipping designs in Chrome; not full McCLIM compatibility

limitations: No Bordeaux Threads implementation, automatic runnable-task scheduler, locks, or blocking host-operation integration yet.
Calls into ordinary runtime/library code remain synchronous; suspension through such callbacks (including higher-order functions and CLOS dispatch) requires resumable implementations.
Normal-mode full McCLIM350 startup validation is running; no fullMcCLIM or fullANSI conformance claim.
